source.text: ወነሥኡኒ፡ ውስተ፡ አሐዱ፡ መካን፡ ኀበ፡ እለ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ህየ፡ ከመ፡ እሳት፡ ዘይነድድ፡ ወሶበ፡ ይፈቅዱ፡ ያስተርእዩ፡ ከመ፡ ሰብእ።
source.note: Selected place and fire-like inhabitants retained; no named location or added angelic classification.

translation.text: And they took me into a place where those who were there were like burning fire, and whenever they wished, they appeared like men.[a]

footnotes.text: Or “they showed themselves like men.” The selected verb permits making themselves visible; no class of beings or named place is supplied.

source.text: ወወሰዱኒ፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ዘዐውሎ፡ ወውስተ፡ ደብር፡ ዘክተማ፡ ርእሱ፡ ይበጽሕ፡ እስከ፡ ሰማይ።
source.note: Selected ዐውሎ is storm/whirlwind, not darkness. Mountain head/summit and heaven relation retained without identifying a modern mountain.

translation.text: And they took me to a place of whirlwind and to a mountain whose summit reached to heaven.[a]

footnotes.text: Whirlwind or storm follows the selected ዐውሎ, supported by primary Dillmann1865 column994. The place is not changed to darkness; the selected mountain head/summit expression is not assigned to a modern location.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ መካናተ፡ ብርሃናት፡ ወነጐድጓድ፡ ውስተ፡ *አጽናፍ፡ ኀበ፡ ዕመቃ፡ ኀበ፡ ቀሥተ፡ እሳት፡ ወሐጾ፡ ወምጕንጻቲሆሙ፡ ወሰይፈ፡ እሳት፡ ወመበርቅት፡ ኵሉ።
source.note: Selected starred extremity expression and depth relation retained literally; Charles printed46 note29 flags a possible corruption. No Greek reconstruction or added heavens word adopted. Weapon and lightning terms remain distinct.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Actual selected words retained; Charles note29 suggests corruption, no reconstruction adopted. English copula visibly bracketed. Exact location/relationship not reconstructed.

translation.text: And I saw the places of the lights and of thunder, at the extremities, in the depth, where [there were] the bow of fire, arrows and their quivers, the sword of fire, and all the lightnings.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected starred extremities/depth construction is difficult; Charles1906 printed46 note29 suggests a possible corruption. The English leaves the separate extremity and depth terms literal and supplies only the bracketed copula, without adopting the proposed reconstruction or adding an unprinted heavens relation. The exact location and construction remain uncertain. The weapon sequence is retained, including plural quivers (primary Dillmann1865 column1182 cites17:3), rather than replacing it with storehouses or a general storm description. These limits and the low confidence are essential to this critical rendering.

source.text: ወነሥኡኒ፡ እስከ፡ ማያት፡ ሕያዋን፡ [ዘይትናገር፡] ወእስከ፡ እሳት፡ ዐረብ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ይነሥእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዕርበተ፡ ፀሐይ።
source.note: Selected living-waters form retained; printed46 note37 reports its editorial dependency. Bracketed speaking clause remains selected source but is omitted as the gloss identified by note38, with the omission explained in the anchored note.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Actual Charles printed46 note38 identifies an Ethiopicgloss; no extra speaking agent inserted in mainEnglish.

translation.text: And they took me as far as the living waters[a] and as far as the fire of the west, which receives every setting of the sun.

footnotes.text: Living waters follows selected ሕያዋን. Charles1906 printed46 note37 says this form follows a reported superscription and Greek comparison, rather than most manuscripts in the edited line; that is an editorial dependency, not fresh manuscript inspection. The following selected [ዘይትናገር፡], “which speaks,” remains bracketed in the source and is not represented in the narrative English because note38 identifies it as an Ethiopic gloss. The west/fire and receiving-sunset relation is retained without naming a speaking agent or physical site.

source.text: ወመጻእኩ፡ *እስከ፡ ፈለገ፡ እሳት፡ ዘይውሕዝ፡ እሳቱ፡ ከመ፡ ማይ፡ ወይትከዐው፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ዐቢይ፡ መንገለ፡ ዐረብ።
source.note: Starred selected to/as-far-as relation retained. Fire flows like water; west is a directional rendering, not a named river or proof of earthly geography.

translation.text: And I came to a river of fire, whose fire flowed like water, and it emptied into the great sea toward the west.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected ending gives a direction toward ዐረብ. Primary Dillmann1865 column964 supports west/western quarter, while a geographic Arabia sense exists elsewhere. The English chooses the directional sense, without identifying a particular sea or river.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ ዐበይተ፡ አፍላገ፡ ወእስከ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ጽልመት፡ በጻሕኩ፡ ወሖርኩ፡ ኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ (ኢ)ያንሶሱ።
source.note: Actual source parentheses around the negative ኢ retained. Negative narrative reading is a qualified critical choice; positive alternative remains disclosed, not erased.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Actual selected parentheses retained; no silent choice or normalization into an unqualified source. Whole unit remains low confidence.

translation.text: And I saw great rivers, and I reached as far as the great darkness, and I went to where no flesh walks.[a]

footnotes.text: The actual selected edition prints the negative in parentheses, (ኢ), not an unqualified negative-free clause. This English adopts the negative reading; without it the clause would instead say that all flesh walks there. The source parentheses, low confidence and this alternative are retained as essential controls. The motion verb is checked against the primary Dillmann1865 column386 walking/animate family; the English does not rely on the old OCR-uncertainty note. Flesh is not narrowed to a named group of people.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ አድባረ፡ ቆባሬት፡ እለ፡ ክረምት፡ ወምክዐወ፡ ማይ፡ ዘኵሉ፡ ቀላይ።
source.note: Selected source ቆባሬት personally collated on the PDF84→86 continuation, correcting current ቀበሬት. Primary column436 cites17:7 under ቆባር, gloom/obscurity; the exact selected inflected form is not silently replaced by the headword or Greek winds.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Primary col436 explicit17:7 underቆባር supports gloom range but is not the identical inflected selected spelling; source not normalized and Greek winds not adopted.

translation.text: And I saw the mountains of winter darkness and the outpouring of water from the whole deep.[a]

footnotes.text: The actual selected noun is ቆባሬት, not the current OCR-like ቀበሬት. Primary Dillmann1865 column436 has the gloom/obscurity headword ቆባር and explicitly cites17:7; the printed inflected form is preserved rather than normalized to that headword. Winter follows the selected winter/rainy-season family, not the different winds of a Greek comparison. The whole/all expression modifies the deep, not an all silently moved before waters. The exact geography is not identified, and the low confidence acknowledges the selected form and construction.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ አፉሆሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ አፍላገ፡ ምድር፡ ወአፉሃ፡ ለቀላይ።
source.note: Singular mouth expressions with plural river possessor and singular deep retained. Source does not identify either mouth as an inlet, source or outlet.

translation.text: And I saw the mouth of all the earth’s rivers and the mouth of the deep.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected first expression is singular mouth with a plural possessor for all the rivers, not plural mouths or a separately added mouth of the earth. The repeated mouth relation does not specify sources, inlets or outlets.
